SELECT id, user_id, venue_id, course_id, coach_id, status, book_time, create_time FROM book WHERE status IN (1,3) AND course_id IS NOT NULL

select b.id, u1.nick_name,b.venue_id, v.name as venue_name,b.course_id, c.name as course_name,b.coach_id, u2.nick_name as coach_name, b.status, b.book_time from book b LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON b.user_id=u1.user_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON b.venue_id=v.id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id=c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON b.coach_id=u2.user_id where b.user_id=#{userId} and b.status in (3) AND b.id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM book_feedback);
